_comment: Structural extract of the SAGF governance corpus, published to make the synthesis claims of the dissertation independently verifiable. Contains record identifiers, domains, risk and category, and the framework control IDENTIFIERS each record discharges. It deliberately contains no mandard statement, rationale, remediation, tooling reference, or framework control title: the corpus itself is withheld under the terms set out in Appendix F, and control wording belongs to the respective standards bodies. Verify any control identifier against your own licensed copy of the standard.
